mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a boost in demand and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and FEDFUNDS decreases
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% MoM and FEDFUNDS decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals supply-side constraints and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases and CPIAUCSL increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
